notes.rootFontSize: 16px; rem utilities resolve at standard values. Body 14px. Type scale in explicit px; the 11px/16px step is configured but unused.
notes.font: Mona Sans variable (200-900, 75%-125% width), self-hosted at public/fonts (SIL OFL). h1/h2: font-stretch 108%, letter-spacing -0.018em. font-feature-settings ss01.
notes.themes: Light on :root; dark under prefers-color-scheme: dark or data-theme=dark. colorMeta.<token>.dark is the dark value. Tokens are HSL channel variables consumed as hsl(var(--token)). Dark surface order: bg 5.5% < sidebar 7.5% < subtle 8.5% < raised 11.5% < muted 13%.

notes.translucency: App shell: sticky table header (canvas 80% + blur, 95% fallback) and the scrim only. Vault screen: frosted card (raised 80%, 24px backdrop blur) over the WebGL colour field.
notes.vaultField: Fallback: radial-gradient(50% 45% at 50% 55%, hsl(221 83% 53% / 0.35), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(35% 35% at 62% 40%, hsl(258 90% 66% / 0.25), transparent 70%), hsl(var(--sidebar)). Tiers: #93c5fd/#3b82f6, #7c9cf8/#4f46e5, #8b7cf6/#2d1f8f.

narrative.overview:
sThree Browser carries the public portal's look into the app, in its calm form (the user's "B · Calm" choice, 2026-11-05): Mona Sans with a slightly wide cut for titles, pill-shaped actions and navigation, softly rounded containers, a faint top-lit gloss on raised and floating surfaces, and in dark mode a deep blue-violet ink instead of neutral grey. The working shell stays quiet: tone and hairlines separate the planes, one blue marks selection, focus and folders, and motion is limited to state feedback. The portal's spectacle (a living colour field, glow, frosted glass, a 3D logo object) is allowed on the vault screen only, where nothing is being worked on yet.

The interface is made for repeat work, comfortable rather than cramped. A 16px root with a 14px body, 36px controls and 44px listing rows reads at a normal desktop size while a long listing still fits on one screen. Figures use tabular alignment so sizes and dates line up in columns. Security state is part of the chrome: the vault status card, with its countdown ring and Lock pill, sits at the foot of the sidebar on every unlocked screen. Light and dark themes follow the system setting (`prefers-color-scheme`) unless the user picks one.

This supersedes the 2026-11-02 "category standard" visual commitment. The product principles in PRODUCT.md are unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral surfaces in light (white canvas, blue-grey sidebar, near-white bands); a deep blue-violet ink ramp in dark.
Pills for every action, navigation step and filter; rounded rectangles (10, 12, 18, 24px) for containers; 8px for text inputs.
Mona Sans, self-hosted; h1 and h2 in a 108% wide cut with -0.018em tracking; tabular figures for every number.
A glossy primary CTA: a blue pill in light, a white pill in dark.
A faint gloss on raised and floating surfaces; no glows anywhere in the app shell.
Folder icons in blue; file icons and every row action icon in grey.
Monospace only for literal strings the user types or copies verbatim.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue marks selection, focus, progress, folder icons and (in light mode) the primary CTA. It is never a link colour in running text and never a file-type tint: file icons stay Muted Ink and turn Selection Ink only while their row is selected. Folders are the single decorative use, chosen by the user on 2026-11-05.

rules.name: The Grey Actions Rule
rules.body: Action icons stay Muted Ink: row quick actions, "…" menus, header icon buttons, the Settings button. Only a delete icon warms to Danger Red, and only on hover. Coloured action buttons were tried and rejected.

rules.name: The Meaningful State Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only where they carry a state the user must read. User-chosen group colours appear only as the 8px dot beside the group name.

rules.name: The Raised Selection Exception
rules.body: The active sidebar connection is the one selection that is not a blue wash: a Raised pill with gloss, the card shadow and a 1px hairline ring, ink at 500 weight, and its database icon in Selection Ink. In dark mode Raised is the lightest surface, so the pill always lifts off the sidebar; never draw it with `bg`.

rules.name: The Wide Title Rule
rules.body: Every h1 and h2 is set in Mona Sans' wider cut (108%) with -0.018em tracking, from the base stylesheet. The explorer headline pushes it to 112% and -0.025em. Running text, labels and buttons stay at normal width.

rules.name: The px Ramp Rule
rules.body: The root font size is 16px, so rem utilities resolve at their standard values. The body defaults to 14px. The type scale is declared in explicit px with paired line heights (12.5/18, 14/21, 15/22, 17/26, 20/28, 24/32). Touch-critical sizes stay explicit px: listing rows are exactly 44px.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number (sizes, dates, counts, percentages, countdowns, ETags) uses tabular figures in the sans face. Metadata is never set in monospace to make it align.

rules.name: The Literal String Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks strings that must be read or typed exactly: object keys and prefixes (the key block, the drop-target path, the new-folder prefix), the folder name typed to confirm a folder deletion, secret and credential fields, the connection identity fields and the bucket and region identity chips, share URLs, and code or file content. Every other field, including displayed size, type, date, storage class, ETag and the endpoint chip, is sans.

rules.name: The Phantom Column Rule
rules.body: The table is `table-fixed` and uses full-width `colSpan` rows (the parent-folder row). The Modified column therefore renders only at 640px and up through a JS media hook. Never hide a column in this table with CSS alone; it leaves a phantom column.

rules.name: The Search Threshold Rule
rules.body: The sidebar connection search appears only when there are more than 6 connections. Below that the list fits without scrolling and the field is noise.

rules.name: The Shadow-on-Float Rule
rules.body: Real shadows (popover, dialog) belong to layers that sit above the page. Resting elements carry at most `xs` or `card`; the preview frame's soft drop and the CTA shadow are the two named exceptions. Panels, tables and the sidebar are never lifted.

rules.name: The Gloss Rule
rules.body: Gloss goes on Raised surfaces (menus, select lists, the upload tray, the credential and metadata cards, the vault status card, the active connection pill) and on dialogs. Dialogs stay on Canvas under their gloss so the Subtle footer and nested panes read as lighter bands, not as holes.

rules.name: The Calm Shell Rule
rules.body: The app shell has no glows, colour fields or frosted glass. Translucency there is limited to the sticky table header and the 2px scrim blur. The vault screen is the one place the portal's colour field, glow, frosted card and 3D tiers appear.

rules.name: The Persistent Failure Rule
rules.body: Completed uploads can be dismissed. Failed uploads stay, washed red with the reason in red text, until the user dismisses them. Toasts for other notices appear bottom-right.

rules.name: The No Native Widgets Rule
rules.body: Selects and checkboxes are built in-app, never the operating system's. The Select is an ARIA combobox: focus stays on the trigger, options are announced with `aria-activedescendant`, the list floats in a portal (`data-floating`) positioned against the trigger and flips above when space runs out, and it supports arrows, Home/End, Enter/Space, type-ahead and Escape. Dialogs ignore outside presses and Escape that belong to an open floating list. The Checkbox is a button with `role="checkbox"`, an 18px box with a 5px radius that fills Action Blue with a white check.

dos: **Do** make every button that carries a verb (primary, secondary, danger, outline) a full pill; keep icon-only quiet buttons at 8px.
**Do** drive the primary button from the `--cta` tokens so it is a glossy blue pill in light and a white pill in dark.
**Do** put gloss on Raised and floating surfaces, and keep dialogs on Canvas so their Subtle footer reads as a lighter band.
**Do** colour folder icons Selection Ink with a 15% blue fill, and keep file icons and every action icon in Muted Ink (the One Blue and Grey Actions Rules).
**Do** set h1 and h2 in the 108% wide cut with -0.018em tracking, and every number in tabular sans figures.
**Do** draw row hover and selection as inset 12px-rounded fills (selection with its 1px blue outline), not divider lines.
**Do** keep vault state visible on every unlocked screen, as the countdown-ring card at the sidebar foot.
**Do** make bulk destructive actions show their scope, require typing the target's name, and report progress and errors inside the dialog.
**Do** keep app-shell motion to state feedback (100–150ms fills, a 0.98 press, 200ms dialogs, drawer and progress), and reduce the vault screen to one still frame under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: **Don't** put glows, colour fields, frosted glass or 3D objects in the app shell; they belong to the vault screen (the Calm Shell Rule).
**Don't** tint file-type icons or action icons, or change the user's group dot colours.
**Don't** use green, amber or red for anything that is not a state.
**Don't** lift resting surfaces beyond `xs` or `card`, except the preview frame's soft drop and the CTA shadow.
**Don't** add uppercase, letter-spaced labels above headings; labels are 12.5px sentence case.
**Don't** load fonts or assets from other origins; Mona Sans is self-hosted.
